tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(docs): clarify HandleSessionEnd's J5 comment does not claim it propagates ss.Delete failures (PR #509 review finding H2)

The J5 paragraph's "propagates a clear failure as an error rather than
swallowing it" describes ss.Delete/deleteFiles's own internal
behavior (it withholds the roster removal on a sidecar-clear failure,
per finding J3), not what HandleSessionEnd does with the error it
gets back -- but placed right before "there is nothing left for a
hook-local duplicate to do," it read as though HandleSessionEnd itself
propagated the failure, directly contradicted by the very next
sentence ("reported to stderr ... non-fatal") and by the code, which
logs and returns nil.

Kept the code as-is: hooks in this package are non-blocking by
design, and the retry-token guarantee (the roster stays in List() for
a later Purge/PurgeTombstoned pass) is already enforced entirely
inside ss.Delete before it ever returns to this function -- returning
nil here does not undercut it, since the roster was already left in
place. Failing the hook here would only make session end unreliable
without improving the guarantee. Reworded the comment to attribute
each behavior to the right function. TestStore_Delete_SidecarClearFailureKeepsRoster
in internal/session/store_test.go already pins the underlying
invariant this comment describes; no behavior changed here so no new
test or CHANGELOG entry.
EOF
)"
